steps.subject: other: base coat
steps.action: work a thin coat of sap green over the dark base
steps.load: picked up with lots of pressure
steps.new: dark base coat under the sap green

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: touch dark cloud color in with lots of pressure
steps.load: van dyke brown and prussian blue equal parts, a little crimson

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: pull thick white with a stiff fan and move it around
steps.load: stiff fan loaded with thick white
steps.motion: move it around and work it in

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend down into the shadow with a clean dry brush
steps.rule: just a few hairs keep the paint where it was placed

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: load knife with blue and brown mix and a touch of white
steps.load: thick roll on the knife edge
steps.motion: bring it up into the area

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: press the knife in to lay the mountain undercoat
steps.motion: press firmly and lift off extra paint
steps.rule: lifting extra paint lets the brush blend it into fog

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add shadow color with a gentle touch of the knife
steps.load: picked up a nice edge of thick paint
steps.motion: touch gently and let it pull

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: add a light touch of sunshine color on the mountain
steps.rule: sunshine color is not named in the transcript

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap a dark green-brown mix to set the mountains back

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap a little texture into the dark
steps.rule: the black undercoat supplies the dark so no extra dark is needed

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: touch light paint from the brush into the light area
steps.motion: light touch and let it pull

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pick up yellows and reds and marble them on the brush
steps.load: marbled on the brush, not mixed

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: lightly touch the marbled color down into the shadow

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pick up cadmium yellow and permanent red and tap them in
steps.load: loosened with liquid clear, then tapped in

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap bright yellow into thick white and place a small bush in front

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add a few more little colors
steps.rule: colors picked from the palette, not named

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add bright color with taps and light touches
steps.rule: keeping the brush loose keeps colors from turning to mud

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pull loose white-tinted paint through with the knife
steps.load: white with a touch of color, loose
steps.rule: lines show things moving around them rather than one line per item

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pull a big stroke up with the knife

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap colors upward with the brush turned over

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add brighter yellow in front with titanium white
steps.load: yellow tapped into thick white, loosened
steps.rule: a brighter front makes it look closer

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: draw a birch trunk line with the knife, then fill it in
steps.motion: draw the line and fill it in

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add another birch line and fill it in
steps.motion: draw the line and fill it in

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: fill in the darker base low down and tap

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: lay three values of burnt umber and white on the birch
steps.load: mixed to three values, not over-mixed
steps.motion: pull and let the paint do the work

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add light on one side of the trees with a light touch
steps.load: white marbled into the brown mix

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: touch thinned green-black into the dark shadow
steps.motion: lightly touch and let it pull
steps.rule: thin paint pulls off on its own

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint branches with a thin black-brown mix using a long-haired liner
steps.motion: bounce the long hairs onto the canvas
steps.rule: long hairs bounce instead of pushing into the canvas

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add small snags and twigs with the liner
steps.rule: otherwise they look like sticks hanging there

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: highlight a few branches with a light touch
steps.rule: light on dark makes the branches stand away

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: add little light touches up high and sun clipping in

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add a larger light shape moving in front
steps.rule: movement breaks the area and keeps the eye in the painting

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting with thin black
steps.rule: thin paint pulls off on its own
